hazards.evidence: A black cord/wire is lying across multiple carpeted stair treads, running diagonally down the staircase where a walker user would step.
Stair carpet is torn, frayed and lifting with loose threads on several treads; step nosings/edges are worn and poorly defined.
Strong direct sunlight creates bright glare on the right side of the treads with deep shadow on the left, giving high-contrast uneven illumination that can obscure step edges.
